name: RC-B10-0372/2025 – After § 1 – Am 40
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Gaza at breaking point: EU action to combat famine, the urgent need to release hostages and move towards a two-state solution
part_text: 1n. Calls on EU and Member State authorities to guarantee the safety, freedom of navigation and unimpeded access of all humanitarian vessels to Gaza, notably the Gaza Sumud Flotilla, and to allow them to bring essential food, water, medicine and medical supplies to Gaza;
